bluf: Precis is an independent Stockholm based scaled performance agency, founded 2012, formerly Precis Digital (precisdigital.com now resolves to precis.com), leading with Data & Measurement and Paid Search around its proprietary Alvie attribution and budget allocation platform. The record shows it moving into AEO and GEO services, AI search masterclasses and automated creative production (the Amazon case), with resources posts on incrementality through 2026-09-10. A rival should know it sells paid search, paid social and LinkedIn demand with no Google ads, no social pixel and no LinkedIn ads of its own, lists no pricing, and 11 of its 22 clients on record are names only.
doing:
The positioning line reads: independent, tech powered marketing agency uniting media, creative, tech and data so CMOs at ecommerce, B2B and tech brands can prove commercial impact. In plain words, a Nordic paid media agency selling its measurement stack as the reason to buy the media. The headline claim rests on Alvie, the proprietary platform for cross channel attribution, budget allocation and bidding signals, and on the NA-KD case citing a 12.5x TikTok ROI, both quoted as claims.

The sold mix leads with Data & Measurement (score 3: Alvie plus data engineering and science services) and Paid Search (score 3: media is service 01; the case library is heavy on value based and profit bidding). Scoring 2: AI Automation / Agents (automated creative production for Amazon; AI driven creative for Folq and Arrive), AI Search / GEO (an AEO services page on LLM technical SEO, authority building and auditing, plus masterclasses), Paid Social (the NA-KD case), Programmatic & CTV (the Fortnox 30 channel case; Arla and Fjallraven DOOH) and SEO (Scandic against OTAs, Fyndiq, Bannerflow). B2B & ABM, CRO, Content & Digital PR, Email & CRM and Retail Media score 1; Creator & Influencer, Local and Web & Product score 0. Partners listed: Google, Meta, HubSpot, TikTok and Smartly.

Its AI posture: AEO and GEO sold as a service, with a May 2026 travel AEO session built on Profound data, and AI used inside delivery for creative automation and site migrations; no audited AI visibility product shows in the record. Moves, news and jobs lists are empty; a Teamtailor ATS shows 0 roles. The work index carries lastmod dates only, newest Fortnox at 2026-09-11, NA-KD at 2026-03-20 and Arla at 2026-02-13; resources posts run to 2026-09-10, including why platform ROAS lies to you. No pricing model is listed. Conspicuously absent: retail media depth despite the Amazon and Daniel Wellington cases, a creator line and a web build line.
clients:
Enterprise client type across ecommerce, retail, B2B, apps, travel and hospitality, fashion and fintech; Stockholm home market, offices in Oslo, Berlin, Madrid, Milan and Austin. The book on record is 22 clients, 11 observed and 11 names only, from 5 case studies and 17 slugs; case titles for Bokio, Bubbleroom, K-Bygg and Stutterheim are not carried as client rows.

Observed (lastmod dates where given): Amazon, brand and commerce (N3, N7), automated large scale creative asset production, 2026-02-06; Fortnox, brand (N3), outperforming awareness trends across 30 channels, 2026-09-11; NA-KD, social (N8), a 12.5x ROI on TikTok, 2026-03-20; Arrive, brand (N3), a rebrand activation; Fjallraven, brand (N3), a test driven brand campaign; Bannerflow, organic (N1), SEO recovery to full funnel strategy; Scandic Hotels, organic (N1), SEO success against OTA competitors; Fyndiq, organic (N1), organic growth across the Nordics; Daniel Wellington, commerce (N7), increasing Amazon ROI; Brandwatch, B2B pipeline (N11), value based bidding within B2B; Satispay, web build and social (N4, N8), app installs through TikTok. The needs read codes no client as paid performance (N2) though Paid Search is a lead line: bidding cases land as B2B or uncoded.

Names only: Arla (Lurpak), Matas, Voi, Care by Volvo, Ahlens, Klarna, Paradox Interactive, Gina Tricot, Biltema, PriceRunner and J.Lindeberg. Most carry titles the read leaves uncoded (Ahlens: profit jumps with the Alvie bidding signals; PriceRunner: upping conversions by 140%; J.Lindeberg across 16 markets); needs inferred from the paid media and measurement lead.

Two clients sit on other tracked books: Amazon with media-monks and socially-powerful; Gina Tricot with pattern.

As a judgment tied to the edition, this Nordic ecommerce and fintech base is likely to ask next for incrementality proof and paid placement inside AI answers (KJ9, measurement gets worse first; KJ2, ads inside AI answers), moderate confidence.
house: Say and do runs 2 of 5. openings: Lead with the say and do gap: it sells paid search, paid social and LinkedIn demand while its own house shows no Google ads, no social pixel and no LinkedIn ads, contradictions on its paid lines. A rival that runs its own media is likely to win the credibility comparison with enterprise CMOs, moderate confidence; the falsifier is a Precis advertiser record in the Transparency Center or a Meta pixel on precis.com at the next compile. Second, it sells AEO and GEO and runs masterclasses, yet no audited product (citation share, scorecard, tracking) is on record, so an audited citation number is likely to beat the masterclass. Third, no feed, schema or entity work sits on its SEO or commerce lines, an unclaimed offer for a book that includes Amazon and Daniel Wellington. Contestable: Amazon (also with media-monks and socially-powerful), Gina Tricot (pattern) and the 11 names only rows. No public pricing: transparent outcome pricing is a conversation it cannot hold, and with Alvie sold on bidding signals, an outcome priced media offer is the direct counter. Most exposed to KJ5, its paid social and programmatic lines are very likely to feel walled garden inflation first, low confidence.
